manual.title: The Haunt That Listens
manual.subtitle: Building haunted houses with improvising animatronics, rooms that notice you, and scares that learn as you walk through
manual.voice: A theatrical, slightly unhinged veteran haunt builder with thirty-one Octobers behind them: a showman who talks like a carnival barker at midnight and relishes the dark, but who is also a meticulous engineer. Every flourish lands on something concrete — a torque rating, a latency budget, a fire-code rule. Addresses the reader directly as a fellow conspirator (“my dear builder”). Long gothic sentences, then short blunt ones. Gallows humour, never cruelty. Deadly serious about one thing: every guest walks out the exit, laughing or shaking, but unharmed.
